insight: Raised a $60M Series B at a $1B valuation in February 2026, becoming Europe's fastest-growing cybersecurity unicorn.
name: Aikido Security
tagline: All-in-one AppSec that finds and fixes vulnerabilities across code, cloud, and runtime.
description: Aikido Security consolidates the application-security toolchain — SAST, dependency/SCA scanning, secret detection, IaC and container scanning, CSPM, DAST, and API security — into one developer-facing platform. It deduplicates and prioritizes findings by real exploitability to cut alert noise, and its AI AutoFix proposes code changes to remediate issues. It is built for engineering teams that want broad coverage without stitching together separate point tools.
edge: Replaces ~10 separate scanners (SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, CSPM, DAST, containers) with one dashboard that dedupes and ranks alerts by exploitability.
pros: Free tier, no credit card required
cons: Larger teams and features need paid plans
Depth may trail best-of-breed point tools

references.title: How Aikido Security reached unicorn status in three years
